name: Convex Transact
description: Execute a signed transaction against a Convex peer. Prefer an s/<name> reference to a seed generated by convex:generate-key; literal seeds remain supported for compatibility and are redacted from job records.

address.description: Origin account address to use for the transaction

source.description: Convex Lisp source code to transact

seed.description: An s/<name> secret reference containing the Ed25519 seed. A literal hexadecimal seed is accepted only for compatibility.

errorCode.description: Error code, if an error occurred

result.description: Result of the query, as Convex printed data structure.

value.description: Result of the query, as JSON (some type distinctions may be lost).
